Third-party files, not written for this project, used unmodified apart from removing a source map link.
audio_bundle.mjs and wasm/: @mediapipe/tasks-audio 1.1.1 from npm, Google, Apache-2.0. Newer builds use relaxed SIMD, which Safari can't load.
yamnet.tflite: YAMNet audio classifier from Google's MediaPipe model storage.
